20261118-physics-e4.s.s1.prompt: For one beam balance, dem hang 20 g weight for 4 marks to di left of di pivot. How much weight must dem hang for 2 marks to di right of di pivot to make am level?
20261118-physics-e4.s.s1.explain: By di principle of balance, di moment of di left side ($4\text{marks} \times 20\text{ g} = 80$) and di moment of di right side ($2\text{marks} \times ? = 80$) must equal, so you must hang $40\text{ g}$ weight.
